description: Reporte Índice de Calidad de Aguas Marinas y Costeras - ICAM is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Instituto de Investigaciones Marinas y Costeras José Benito Vives de Andreis, Magdalena. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto de Investigaciones Marinas y Costeras José Benito Vives de Andreis, Magdalena. Its tags are calidad del agua, calidad de recursos hídricos, información ambiental marino, colombia, invemar. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible. The portal shows 2025-03-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
